from pathlib import Path
import json
files=[]
for p in sorted(Path('/diagnostic-logs').iterdir()):
 if p.is_file() and (p.name.startswith('debug.log') or p.name.startswith('neo4j.log')) and not p.name.endswith('.gz'):
  lines=p.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines()
  pause=[s for s in lines if 'VmPauseMonitor' in s or 'stop-the-world' in s]
  heap=[s for s in lines if any(k in s.lower() for k in ['heap','pagecache','page cache','initialheapsize','maxheapsize'])]
  files.append({'file':p.name,'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'line_count':len(lines),'pause_lines':pause,'heap_pagecache_lines':heap})
print(json.dumps({'files':files,'interpretation':'Empty pause list means no pause warning recorded in these inspected logs, not no GC.'}))
